name: Limit Break Payment Processor V2 forwarded-calldata offset sender spoof
summary: Payment Processor V2 copies a forwarded call's trade data from the caller-supplied ABI offset but sizes the copy as if the offset were canonical. Sending offset 0 through a permissionless trusted forwarder shifts the copy, drops the forwarder-appended real sender and lets attacker bytes become the ERC-2771 sender, so the attacker could act as any wallet that had approved Payment Processor: accepting its own zero-price offers for victims' NFTs and making victims buy worthless listings with approved WETH and stablecoins.

loss.notes: Exact victim ERC-20 debits from spoofed buy-listing calls on Ethereum, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum (sibling V2 deployments) and ApeChain (PP V3, identical modifier, same actors and forwarder 0xb48d6af77c5e3b99876ea71b38e9c814ba5b1c8e), totalling $1,665,921.59 at DefiLlama prices of each asset's first drain. The stolen NFTs (at least 84612 ERC721 items and 77264 ERC1155 units from 12769 Ethereum wallets, plus the other-chain events counted in source-3) are unvalued, so this amount is a lower bound; SlowMist reports about $2.8M. Scan ends: Ethereum block 26078818, Base 51922870, Polygon 94620091, Arbitrum 509846310, BNB 124606568, OP 157518303, ApeChain 50588304; later drains are not included.

ageReset.description: Immutable PaymentProcessor V2 runtime contains the fixed 68-byte offset assumption in delegateCallReplaceDomainSeparator; permissionless forwarder registration and collection settings add no causal configuration.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause and earliest exercise. Source-5 PaymentProcessor.acceptOffer/buyListing/bulk*/sweepCollection(bytes data) delegate through modifier delegateCallReplaceDomainSeparator, which sets lengthWithAppendedCalldata = calldatasize()-68 and calldatacopy(ptr+4, data.offset, lengthWithAppendedCalldata): it assumes the canonical ABI offset 0x20 (data.offset == 68) and never checks it. ModuleTrades.acceptOffer then sets appendedDataLength = msg.data.length-1060-32*proof.length and taker = appendedDataLength==20 ? _msgSender() : msg.sender, where _msgSender() returns the last 20 calldata bytes when TrustedForwarderFactory 0xff0000b6c4352714cce809000d0cd30a0e0c8dce.isTrustedForwarder(msg.sender) (buyListing: base length 900, same taker rule). A forwarded call whose offset word is 0 makes the copy start 32 bytes early and end 32 bytes before calldatasize, dropping the forwarder-appended real sender and exposing attacker bytes as the ERC-2771 sender, so the taker (seller for acceptOffer, paying buyer for buyListing) is any address that approved Payment Processor. Anchor source-1 (block 26047513, tx index 13, ts 1790255279): EOA 0x0e9e147af2108e5354efb28740cade8e7422d1c7 (nonce 0) creates 0x74002203ddfce44e5514b3945db4db17948c6d8e, whose constructor makes 70 calls to TrustedForwarder clone 0xb233e3602bb06aa2c2db0982bbaf33c2b15184c9 forwardCall(address,bytes) 0x22bee494 (signer unset, appends msg.sender). debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): each PP call (selector 0x08fdd68e, 1144 bytes) has word@4 = 0 and ends victim 0xddf2163205e63c5b17c81647be1b73f918535d38 || 12 zero bytes || 0x74002203...; the ModuleTrades 0x9a1d0059f5534e7a6c6c4dae390ebd3a731bd7dc delegatecall 0xe35bb9b7 is 1080 bytes (1080-1060=20) ending with the victim; isTrustedForwarder(0xb233...) returns 1; ecrecover returns the attacker as offer maker; transferFrom(victim, attacker) moves 50 Otherdeed Expanded 0x790b2cf29ed4f310bf7641f013c65d4560d28371, 10 Meebits 0x7bd29408f11d2bfc23c34f18275bbf23bb716bc7, 10 World of Women 0xe785e82358879f061bc3dcac6f0444462d4b5330 for salePrice 0 WETH (70 AcceptOfferERC721 logs from logIndex 180). Forwarder registration is permissionless (source-5 cloneTrustedForwarder is external and sets forwarders[clone]=true); later actors cloned their own, e.g. 0xb48d6af77c5e3b99876ea71b38e9c814ba5b1c8e by 0x415f981b474b2e060d314bec14461d9aeef70b1a in source-10 (block 26052371, TrustedForwarderCreated 0xa853f409d7f35adcac6fe80e553b39788513690b76400aca5a478ecc51bdba36). Earliest-use scan: eth_getLogs on 0x9a1d00bed7cd04bcda516d721a596eb22aac6834 topics0 [AcceptOfferERC721 0x8b87c0b049fe52718fe6ff466b514c5a93c405fb0de8fbd761a23483f9f9e198, BuyListingERC721 0xffb29e9cf48456d56b6d414855b66a7ec060ce2054dcb124a1876310e1b7355c, AcceptOfferERC1155 0x6f4c56c4b9a9d2479f963d802b19d17b02293ce1225461ac0cb846c482ee3c3e, BuyListingERC1155 0x1217006325a98bdcc6afc9c44965bb66ac7460a44dc57c2ac47622561d25c45a], blocks 19142797..26047512: 106404 events in 79334 txs. eth_getTransactionByHash: taker (topic1) equals tx.from for 105269; the other 1135 events (836 txs) were all traced: 1123 PP calls, 898 via trusted forwarders with offset word 0x20 and module tail == appended sender, 225 direct canonical calls; no non-canonical offset before source-1. Reviewed gross fungible victim depletion; NFTs counted, not valued. Buy-listing leg (spoofed taker = paying buyer): eth_getLogs PP V2 Ethereum blocks 26040000..26078818 returns 246120 logs; BuyListing events 2669 in 1084 txs, first source-7 (block 26053260, index 0), last source-8 (block 26078657, index 2, ts 1790631107). callTracer of all 1084: 2669 buyListing calls 0xc32dacae, each from a factory forwarder (0xb48d6af77c5e3b99876ea71b38e9c814ba5b1c8e, 0x39c163e82d4e80be58d622a6e7b91598f6d5852f, 0x432d3bc8d14b84c5a2dfd4c204d9782a0907364f, 0x65df0f9c5a9698cfc19864d71ce15780b2662f1f, 0x5ebc127fae83ed5bdd91fc6a5f5767e259df5642) with offset word 0 and module tail != appended sender; every event buyer is such a spoofed taker. ApeChain PP V3 (identical modifier) blocks 50088304..50588304, 10050 events: spoofed buyListing txs 0xb1bd040821e6284ae25d2aed7d46a28a7668fefe2a02ff52706415f193f71f0b (block 50242874) and 0x0b1b04832936d9e052779674bce84e1871faa0dd5ac96c778634e0b2fbc1cc85 (block 50349425), 29 calls via forwarder 0xb48d6af7..., WAPE 7680022686620044716122 + 11935267623553621172. Valuation: DefiLlama at each asset's first drain on its chain (sources 12-25). NFT leg (spoofed taker = seller, price 0 or dust): Ethereum AcceptOffer events from source-1 onward with taker != tx.from: 107506 ERC721 and 12796 ERC1155; takers with empty eth_getCode at the event block cannot originate calls, proving the spoof for 84612 ERC721 items and 9619 ERC1155 events (77264 units) across 12769 victims and 3583 collections; 22894 ERC721 and 3177 ERC1155 events have EIP-7702 or contract takers and were not individually traced. 833 zero-price events with taker == tx.from are excluded. taker != tx.from AcceptOffer events elsewhere: Base 85895 ERC721 + 38665 ERC1155, Polygon 40309 + 24530, ApeChain V3 9523 + 499, Arbitrum 167, BNB 41, OP 41. Stolen NFTs span thousands of collections and were dispersed to over a thousand accounts (source-1 attacker alone sent 304 NFTs to 54 recipients), so no realised-proceeds or cited floor valuation is attached; loss.usd is a lower bound excluding NFTs (source-11 reports about $2.8M including them). Attacker payments of dust and fees are not netted; later recoveries are ignored.

Reviewed target identity and age history. PaymentProcessor V2 is a direct, non-proxy runtime: module addresses (_moduleTrades etc.) and the EIP-712 values are immutable, it has no owner (owner() reverts) and no upgrade or selfdestruct path; admin-like functions only edit per-collection or per-whitelist settings owned by collections, none involved in the exploited path. eth_getCode empty at block 19142796; codehash 0x7f710dbe02ec41992287c9782a9d0dc237cb630d8677c7be3bc2936a0a691b45 at 19142797 and 26047512. Source-6 (block 19142797, index 14) is a call from 0x67985b1f8b613b57077bbdb24a5defcdda458317 to CREATE2 deployer 0x4e59b44847b379578588920ca78fbf26c0b4956c, whose CREATE2 frame creates the PP. The defect is the modifier's fixed 68-byte offset assumption in this runtime. ModuleTrades 0x9a1d0059f5534e7a6c6c4dae390ebd3a731bd7dc (codehash 0xf58ab846b69620d00ae7853204389da4c357a179d7201b89d7c0f1661ffbf836, empty at 19142774, created block 19142775 tx 0xdb4032d8f29227823b4af008c75494850b4d25f28fab786669f2a64ad8e3ed9c index 35, unchanged at 26047512) applies standard ERC-2771 tail reading to calldata the PP composed; it is immutably wired and older, so it is not the knot. TrustedForwarderFactory (created block 19142047) and the used clone 0xb233e360... (block 19170505) are not age resets: any caller can register a forwarder at any time, and campaign actors did. Sibling V2 runtimes at the same address on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, BNB and OP differ only in immutables; ApeChain V3 carries the same modifier (source-5). Deployment is the age basis: 1790255279-1706902139 = 83353140 s.

limitations: Stolen NFTs are counted but not valued; loss.usd covers only exactly measured ERC-20 victim debits and is a lower bound.
Ethereum NFT events with EIP-7702 or contract takers (22894 ERC721, 3177 ERC1155) and other-chain NFT events are classified by taker != transaction sender, not individually traced.
The campaign was still active at the scan end blocks listed in loss.notes; later drains are excluded.
